_comment: Everything that ships in azookey-setup.exe without a manifest to declare it,
plus the licenses no cataloguer can read off Package.resolved.
Consumed by scripts/generate_supplemental_sbom.py; see its docstring.
Rule for the entries below: nothing here is taken on trust when the workflow
already states it. Every 'verify' block is checked against
.github/workflows/actions.yml before a single component is emitted, and a
checksum the workflow pins that no entry claims fails the build too. Bumping
a download therefore means editing both files, which is the point.
Keyed by the pin identity in server-swift/Package.resolved. Package.resolved
records no license, so these come from the upstream repositories and are the
one part of this file with no automatic cross-check. Re-read the upstream
LICENSE when a pin moves to a new major version.
Keyed by the path in .gitmodules. The version in the SBOM is the commit the
superproject records, which is what post_build copies into build/.

server-swift/azooKey_dictionary_storage.description: azooKey conversion dictionary. The upstream repository carries no LICENSE file, hence NOASSERTION.

server-swift/azooKey_emoji_dictionary_st.description: azooKey emoji dictionary. The upstream repository carries no LICENSE file, hence NOASSERTION.

_comment_unclaimed_workflow_sha256_env: Checksums the workflow pins for things that do NOT ship, and so have no
component below. Inno Setup compiles the installer; it is not inside it.

bundled.name: llama.cpp (AVX CPU backend)
bundled.description: Prebuilt llama.cpp from the fork azooKey for Windows links against; provides llama.dll for Zenzai inference. Also the source of server-swift/llama.lib.

bundled.name: llama.cpp (CUDA 12.4 backend)
bundled.description: Prebuilt llama.cpp with CUDA acceleration, selected by the Zenzai backend setting.

bundled.name: llama.cpp (Vulkan backend)
bundled.description: Prebuilt llama.cpp with Vulkan acceleration, selected by the Zenzai backend setting.

bundled.name: zenz-v3.2-small-gguf
bundled.description: The neural kana-kanji conversion model Zenzai runs, shipped as build/zenz.gguf. The purl carries no revision on purpose: the workflow fetches the file from the moving 'main' ref and pins it by the SHA256 below, so the checksum is what identifies these bytes.

bundled.name: Swift runtime for Windows
bundled.description: The Swift runtime DLLs (swiftCore.dll, dispatch.dll and the rest of usr/bin) that post_build copies out of the installed toolchain and the installer ships. No download of its own: the version is whatever toolchain the build used, which the workflow pins.
